title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At an elite academy, student council president Miyuki Shirogane and vice president Kaguya Shinomiya each refuse to confess love first, since confessing means 'losing'. They scheme to force the other to confess, and after they finally do, the story turns to their relationship and their friends.
life_message: It holds up dropping pride to be honest about love and need.
